title: AI Automation Engineer
description: Company Description: Propper International began in 1967 as a contract manufacturer for the U.S. Navy and has since supplied more than 120 million garments to the U.S. Department of Defense, law enforcement, and public safety agencies. The company’s heritage as a contract manufacturer shapes a culture that values features, quality, and demonstrable performance over lifestyle marketing. Propper focuses on practical innovation and durability, guided by the principles “Make it Work. Make it Last. Make it Real.” This commitment to concrete results drives how products are designed, produced, and delivered to customers. Applicants will join a brand that combines retail presence with a rigorous, mission-driven manufacturing mindset.Role DescriptionIt is a remote position to work from Tunisia.
